# Rajawali D'Cabin Chalet

> Muslim-friendly riverside chalet and homestay in Chendering, Kuala Terengganu, Malaysia. Eight private cabins for family staycations near the city.

Rajawali D'Cabin Chalet offers eight private wooden cabins along the river in Chendering, a short drive from central Kuala Terengganu. The site supports online booking with a flexible RM50 deposit per room and provides guests a self-serve way to manage their reservations.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the chalet, amenities, nearby attractions, and FAQs.
- [Book a Cabin](/book): Check availability and reserve a private cabin online.

## Optional

- [Find your booking](/find-booking): Recover a lost booking management link by email.

_Note: owner sign-in, booking management, and unsubscribe pages are private utility routes and intentionally excluded._
